definitions.explanation: Indicates that a reservation or booking has been completed.

examples.japanese: この{席|せき}は{予約済|よやくず}みです。
ホテルは{予約済|よやくず}みなので、{安心|あんしん}してください。
examples.english: The hotel is already booked, so don't worry.

examples.japanese: {予約済|よやくず}みの{確認|かくにん}メールが{届|とど}いたら、{当日|とうじつ}は{受付|うけつけ}で{名前|なまえ}を{伝|つた}えるだけでいい。
examples.english: Once you receive the reservation confirmation email, on the day itself you just need to give your name at reception.

notes:
Composed of {予約|よやく} (reservation) and {済|す}み (completed, done — the noun form of {済|す}む). The ～{済|す}み suffix is a productive pattern meaning "already done" or "completed," and attaches to many nouns and verb stems.

USAGE:
- Can function as a noun or a no-adjective: {予約済|よやくず}みの{席|せき} (a reserved seat)
- Often seen on signs, labels, and in written notifications
- The ～{済|す}み pattern is very productive: {支払|しはら}い{済|す}み (paid), {確認|かくにん}{済|す}み (confirmed), {登録|とうろく}{済|す}み (registered)

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {予約済|よやくず}みの{席|せき}: a reserved seat
- {予約済|よやくず}みの{部屋|へや}: a booked room
- {予約済|よやくず}みの{確認|かくにん}: reservation confirmation

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {予約|よやく}{完了|かんりょう}: reservation completed — more formal; used in system messages
- {確保|かくほ}{済|す}み: secured — broader; used for resources, seats, or items that have been secured
- {手配|てはい}{済|す}み: arranged — implies the arrangement or procurement has been completed
